---
title: "How do I simulate a sampling distribution of means?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I simulate a sampling distribution of means?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Choose a model for observations and a sample size.

2. Repeat random sampling many times and compute each mean.

3. Plot the distribution of the sample means.

## Runnable example

```{r}
set.seed(42)
means <- replicate(1000,mean(rexp(30,rate=1/5)))
h <- hist(means,breaks=25,col="#CEE2F0",border="#244967",
          xlab="Sample mean",main="Repeated means of skewed data")
abline(v=5,col="#A35E20",lwd=2,lty=2)
legend("topright",legend="Model mean = 5",lty=2,col="#A35E20",bty="n")
print(c(mean_of_means=mean(means),sd_of_means=sd(means)))
```

## Interpret the result

Each histogram value is a mean from 30 independently simulated observations. The distribution of means is narrower than the original exponential model.

## Check before using your own data

Simulation assumptions and sample size matter; a bell-shaped simulated result is not proof about an unrelated real dataset.
